mapper.select: SELECT T.FINPROD_ID AS financialProductCode, 0 AS branchNumber FROM FIN_PRODUCT T WHERE T.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT T1.PORTFOLIO_ID AS combinedCode, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID AS subcombinedCode, T2.PROFIT_TYPE AS profitType, T3.DIS_PERCENT AS disPercent FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T1 INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_DIS T3 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{financialProductCode}
